title: Readonly OperationalStore и LifecycleProjection пропускают committed WAL
impact_rationale: Recoverable stale owner state while a normal WAL writer remains open; runtime completion appears RUNNING until checkpoint/close. No scientific promotion breach demonstrated.
expected: COMPLETE in independent SQLite reader, public OperationalStore readonly reader and LifecycleProjection
actual: reference=COMPLETE; product store=RUNNING; projection=RUNNING; after writer close=COMPLETE
first_broken_boundary: SQLite committed WAL -> immutable readonly connection
root_cause_confidence: HIGH: both readers use mode=ro&immutable=1; independent mode=ro sees the same writer commit; close/checkpoint control removes disagreement
alternative_explanations: Wrong job/id/cache rejected by exact keyed SELECT and writer-close control. Read-only inventory unchanged.
minimal_reproducer: launch.ps1 -Phase wal -Attempt <new>; six operations retained in product_probes.wal_probe
recommended_bounded_outcome: WAL-aware current readonly views without creating or writing source state; preserve explicit frozen-snapshot semantics where intended
acceptance: same writer-open proof returns COMPLETE from both production readers; no source inventory mutation; readonly/missing/legacy consumers still fail closed
authority_needs: Separate exact repair contract and current Delivery Harness

title: Реальный завершённый DocumentRunner run теряется в owner dossier
impact_rationale: Persistent cross-consumer diagnostic gap: a valid exact-spec completed run is NO_RUN at the owner boundary. Scientific guard correctly blocks promotion, so false alpha/promotion is not demonstrated.
frequency: 3/3 graded consumer attempts, including one fresh standalone producer store; a1 retained as supporting ungraded observation
expected: execution=COMPLETED for matching ExperimentSpec SHA256, evidence remains insufficient and PROMOTE_BLOCKED
actual: RUN_COMPLETED passport matches exact spec SHA256; event has no experiment_id/experiment_spec_id; dossier execution=NO_RUN, PROMOTE_BLOCKED
first_broken_boundary: DocumentRunner durable event identity -> compose_experiment_dossier DIRECT run discovery
root_cause_confidence: HIGH for observed boundary: producer preserves spec hash but no explicit experiment identity; consumer derives DIRECT run IDs only from explicit experiment keys. Exact input identity and retained producer state independently checked.
alternative_explanations: Spec mismatch rejected by passport/spec hash equality; ResearchStore remains readable and unchanged. No scientific records added by bridge. The disposable definition slot is an explicitly declared operator input, not a manufactured evidence join.
recommended_bounded_outcome: Persist explicit source-bound experiment identity on DocumentRunner execution events and prove native owner dossier linkage; preserve current scientific guard strength
acceptance: same standalone producer/bridge returns execution=COMPLETED for the exact spec, unrelated same-title records remain unrelated, PROMOTE remains BLOCKED until real obligations are present, GET is zero-write
authority_needs: Separate exact cross-consumer repair contract; architecture review of event identity compatibility
